Hi everyone!

HomeView switches to whoever walks up to it. It knows up to six people by face and voice, so everyone gets their own home screen, and "play music" plays from the right person's library. [...] Report

Igor Gurovich

The face-and-voice recognition per person is the detail I find most interesting. I work on a voice AI that phones aging parents every day, and the hardest part has been getting older users to trust a voice they can't see. Does HomeView let a guest or a family member check in on someone's home screen remotely, or is everything strictly local to whoever is standing in front of it? Curious how you are thinking about shared households with an older adult.
